subject: CI of modularity.test and other issues

messages.author: 9a32a980c8ed0822
messages.subject: CI of modularity.test and other issues
parts:
Hello all,
I've encountered an issue with CI estimation using the modularity.test function. After running several samples, I consistently get the same CI value as the estimated observed CR. Additionally, the bootstrapped CR values ($CR.boot) also repeatedly show this same estimated CR. I am currently using the latest version of geomorph (4.0.5).

Furthermore, I am facing challenges when interpreting the results of the modularity test. In some of my samples, the z values round to approximately -2, while the CR is calculated to be 1.007. Although the z values suggest a slight modular signal, the CR coefficient does not support this finding. Could you provide recommendations for handling this situation?

Thank you.
